```{r}
required <- c("readr", "DT", "knitr")
missing <- required[!vapply(required, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)]
if (length(missing)) stop("Missing report package(s): ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))
root <- normalizePath(file.path("..", "..", "02_analysis", "output", "stage1"), mustWork = TRUE)
read_table <- function(name) readr::read_csv(file.path(root, "tables", name), show_col_types = FALSE)
show_table <- function(x, caption) DT::datatable(x, caption = caption, rownames = FALSE,
  filter = "top", options = list(pageLength = 10, scrollX = TRUE))
show_figure <- function(name) knitr::include_graphics(file.path(root, "figures", name))
```

# Scope

This stage examines associations between early-life exposures, maternal and
birth characteristics, and growth during the 0–3- and 3–6-month periods. The
analysis is performed by `02_analysis/02_stage1.R`; this report only reads its
saved outputs. This report covers additional growth analyses in male infants with blood samples. Results from these analyses are not reported in the manuscript.
